## Offline evals

- **Gold set:** Pinned BEIR subsets (SciFact ~5k, NFCorpus ~3.6k, FiQA sample) + Amazon ESCI attribute-heavy slice; CPU-only on GitHub-hosted runners
- **Metrics:** nDCG@10; recall@100; vs BM25 / dense-only / BM25+dense RRF baselines; losses published alongside wins

## Online metrics

- Task success: Quickstart completion rate (opt-in telemetry)
- Feedback: GitHub issues/discussions; star and download growth around launch moments
- Ops health: Median issue first-response < 72h (solo-sustainable); external contributor count >= 3 in 90 days

## Observability

- p95 latency: Latency regression test on 100k-item local corpus per release
- Errors: CI green on every release (benchmark + integration suites)
- Drift: Benchmark score drift vs pinned baseline flagged per release
- Evidence coverage: Every result carries per-channel provenance (FR-06)
- Cost/task: Cost per 1k items on optional LLM-scoring path, tracked in bench output

## Versioning & replay

Versioned: dimension schema (semver), embedding model IDs, fusion config, scorer prompts, dataset pins.
Replay: Deterministic: content hash + schema version + model IDs reproduce any projection; fusion seedable; any ranked result reconstructable from source + pins.
